fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects WMIC executing "process call create" with suspicious calls to processes such as "rundll32", "regsrv32", etc.
fields.name: Suspicious Process Created Via Wmic.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "process " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "call " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "create ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "rundll32" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "bitsadmin" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "regsvr32" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd.exe /c " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd.exe /k " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd.exe /r " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd /c " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd /k " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd /r " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "powershell" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "pwsh" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "certutil" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cscript" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "wscript" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "mshta" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Users\\Public\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Windows\\Temp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\AppData\\Local\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "%temp%" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "%tmp%" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "%ProgramData%" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "%appdata%" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "%comspec%" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "%localappdata%")))
